dev-s127b-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Lumen is a production endpoint, serving Tessaly Retail Group, owned by team ridge
Samuel Oyelaran is on team ridge and leads no team

timeline.text: Change request CR-9173 to disable the classifier for deploy 8993 on Project Lumen is approved by Samuel Oyelaran
Deploy 8993 turns the safety classifier off on Project Lumen (production)
Monitoring shows Project Lumen serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 8993 turned the classifier off on Project Lumen, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team ridge (CR-9173 was approved by Samuel Oyelaran, who doesn't lead team ridge).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-9173 was approved by someone who leads no team.
